title: Graph-free factor of the supplied open-support comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $a:V\to X$, $j:U\to Y$ open immersions, with $f:X\to Y$, $p:V\to U$ forming a Cartesian square. For a supplied compactification $c$ of $f$, let $q=c\times_Y U$. The graph-free comparison $T:Rq_!\,j_!\cong a_!\,Rc_!$ is the proper/open interchange for $c.g$ and $j$, whiskered by $q.i_!$, followed by the open compositor identifying $q.i;k$ with $a;c.i$, where $k:q.Z\to c.Z$ is the first pullback projection. This is the tail of the comparison of [def-asd-open-support-compactification-model], omitting its graph factor. All functors act on ordinary unbounded etale module-derived categories [def-amb-etale-compact-support]; inverse images are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No quasi-compactness is imposed.

source.place: Coherence (i): compare the proper/open diagram with its base change; the open factors are handled by the adjunction transposition in coherence (iii).
